% Checks a case the fix of \pdfxformname must not break: a form's name read
% inside the general text of \pdfliteral, which the PDF writes into the
% page's content and does not show. On the page the text around it stays.
\pdfoutput=1
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\setbox2\hbox{form}\pdfxform2
Literal: before\pdfliteral{q /Fm\pdfxformname\pdflastxform\space Do Q} after.
\end{document}
